what_it_is: Percentage of Hawker Centres and Coffeeshops Ready to Implement Gender Ratio Requirement in Public Toilets

sections.label: Code of Practice on Environmental Health
sections.summary: COPEH specifies minimum numbers of female and male toilet facilities for different premises categories, based on Gross Floor Area or capacity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The Code of Practice on Environmental Health or COPEH, specifies the minimum number of female and male toilet facilities for different categories of premises, according to their Gross Floor Area or capacity.

sections.label: Female to male toilet ratio
sections.summary: The 5:3 female to male toilet facility ratio applies to premises such as shopping malls, conference halls and cinemas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The 5:3 ratio of female to male toilet facilities applies to premises such as shopping malls, conference halls and cinemas.

sections.label: Toilet Improvement Programme for hawker centres
sections.summary: NEA will encourage hawker centre and coffeeshop owners to meet latest COPEH through TIP, which co-funds up to 90%, capped at $45,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA will encourage owners and operators of hawker centres and coffeeshops to provide toilet facilities that meet the latest COPEH through the Toilet Improvement Programme or TIP.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The TIP provides co-funding support of up to 90%, capped at $45,000, to incorporate better designs and technologies for more productive and effective cleaning of toilets.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: At the moment for the Toilet Improvement Programme, we have budgeted about $8 million and we are looking at co-funding the programme for up to 40 hawker centres whose common areas and toilets are managed by the Town Councils, and up to 114 coffeeshops.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, our priority and as a start for this Toilet Improvement Programme, it is really for coffeeshops and hawker centres where there is high traffic and we are looking at improving standards of hygiene and cleanliness, particularly with respect to the spread of infectious diseases and so on.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are looking at toilets that have not been upgraded, for instance, for coffeeshops, for the last three years, with ageing infrastructure and maintenance issues.
